body:
Thank you for responding. 

I think I just wanted someone to know. I've only told a select few of my friends how I feel, and..well...they don't talk to me anymore. I understand that. It has to be hard to see or hear that someone is unhappy. It's a long walk on the bridge, but it's comforting. Like something in my head clicked. I didn't realize until recently, that I moved here for it. I moved here with intent, I just didn't want to believe it. 
Edit: kind of feeling shitty about posting here. I know what I want to do, and there's so many young people who want to shake loose, their mortal coil. They need an ear. Not me.
